classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 已有可操作场景、输入与可观察对照；纳入探索队列不等于确认目标版本受影响。

test_spec.setup: REDUNDANT InnoDB t1(a INT,b INT,KEY(b))三行0..2。
test_spec.steps: INSTANT ADD c VARCHAR25 DEFAULT NULL，再UPDATE c为空串 WHERE a=0；SELECT并CHECK。
test_spec.oracle: 应为空串且其他列完整，不能断言/数据损坏；debug与release结果分记。
requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标8.0支持所述SQL/功能；是否仍存在该异常须在各目标版本实测。

explicit_requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志

comments.author: Yin Peng
comments.text: For redundant format, update a field from NULL to empty string can be done inplace. I think the fix could be more precise. Inplace update is allowed only if the field exists in the record.

comments.author: Yin Peng
comments.text:
